if: the revenue is interest, being charges for the use of cash resources or amounts due to the enterprise
no significant uncertainty as to measurability or collectability exists
then: interest is recognised ON A TIME PROPORTION BASIS, taking into account the amount outstanding and the rate applicable
note: Time, not receipt, is the trigger. Discount or premium on debt securities held is treated as though it were accruing over the period to maturity, so it is not a gain on redemption. If measurability or collectability is significantly uncertain, para 13 blocks recognition and ACC-REV-POSTPONE-001 governs instead.
